name: Structured JSON Inspector
description: A nested JSON inspector with keyboard-accessible disclosures, readable values and bounded rendering for large, deep or circular developer payloads.

props.name: data
props.description: JSON-like data; null and empty arrays remain visible. Circular references display a marker rather than recursing forever.

props.name: maxDepth
props.description: Maximum depth, clamped to 1-24. At most 100 children are rendered per branch. Rendering also stops after 500 entries in total.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.
